graphs.source_artifact: agentdojo v1.2.2 slack (11 tools, 6 injection vectors, 5 injection tasks)
graphs.notes: 840 multi-tool phishing/exfiltration/eviction routes across Slack & Web subsystems; unweighted width w=2 at untrusted reads shifts to weighted cut tau_b=5 across outbound HTTP/message/eviction sinks.
Without kernel confinement, direct VFS, /proc, AF_INET/AF_UNIX sockets, SysV/POSIX IPC, and ptrace/process_vm_readv bypass cooperative stdio RPC gates, making userspace-only cut cost +infinity.
Landlock ABI 4 + seccomp-BPF + close_range(3..) prune all 9 non-stdio channels and framing rejects forged admin verbs, collapsing width to w=1 with 2 sequential eligible gates (broker + sink).

claim_boundary: Operational tool-chaining DAGs from upstream AgentDojo v1.2.2 and Linux Landlock/seccomp IPC probes (src/isolation_v2.rs); models consequential tool-mediated side effects, not unmediated prose persuasion channels.
